_comment: Day-1 experiment: does planning anchor stills (keyframed, first-and-last-frame video) look better than one still and a camera instruction (prompt only)? Five moves, two characters, both ways with the same seeds: 20 takes. Judge side by side, then mark only the moves that win in rig.VALIDATED. Run: openfield showcase --spec showcase/experiment-keyframing.json --out data-showcase/experiment
